summary_md: **GitHub ([@github](https://x.com/github/status/2115480207469560109))** says **Copilot Fusion Max** scored within two points of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index at about half the API cost per task; a self-reply discloses that GitHub commissioned and funded the evaluation and links the methodology.

relevance: Cost/performance data point for coding-agent harness choice (vendor-funded, so read with care).

media.description: Artificial Analysis scatter 'Coding Agent Index vs. Cost per Task': GitHub Copilot with Copilot Fusion (max) scores 60 at about $6 per task on the Pareto frontier, versus Claude Code Opus 5.5 (max) at 62 for about $11; Codex, Antigravity, Opencode, Grok Build, DeepSeek Harness and Kimi Code are also plotted.

Bar chart of the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index (FrontierCode v1.1, Terminal-Bench 4.0, SWE-Atlas-QnA-AA): Claude Code Opus 5.5 and Devin Fusion CLI 62, GitHub Copilot Fusion 60, Claude Code Sonnet 5.5 59, Codex GPT-6 Astra 55, down to Kimi Code CLI 41.
